title: Ahrefs Brand Radar: See ANY brand's AI visibility

hook.text: If you're not showing up in AI answers, you're invisible to millions of potential customers.

cta.text: Turn AI into your best sales channel. (VO only, over the ahrefs / Brand Radar end-card lockup; no URL, button or on-screen offer)

summary.tone: Confident, upbeat product-launch narration: brisk and benefit-led with conversational asides ('But wait,', 'Oh, and Reddit?'), heritage- and data-proud in the last third; visually premium and calm, built on one recurring dark-blue-to-peach gradient world that alternates with tilted, highlighted real product UI.

signature_moments.description: A 3D wireframe terrain gains platform logo orbs as each channel is named, then the Ahrefs mark appears with a radar ring and the orbs are gathered into orbit around it, resolving into a sweeping-radar emblem on the product-name line.
signature_moments.why_premium: Turns the product name into a bespoke visual metaphor (a radar scanning every platform) instead of a logo slate, giving the launch a cinematic, brand-owned centrepiece.

signature_moments.description: A horizontal carousel of archival Ahrefs homepages from 2012 onward steps year by year with motion blur and a synced year ticker, then accelerates through the middle years and lands on the current homepage.
signature_moments.why_premium: Converts a credibility claim ('pioneered the SEO industry since 2012') into evidence in about 9 s, with a speed ramp that feels edited rather than templated.

signature_moments.description: Real product screens on a gently tilted, drifting 3D plane, with yellow highlight washes and orange-to-yellow gradient outlines landing on the exact cell, card or column as the VO names it.
signature_moments.why_premium: Word-level sync between narration and UI callouts makes a dense dashboard legible and keeps genuine UI feeling designed rather than screen-recorded.

hook.evidence: Opens straight on a pain statement (w0-w14) over a typed 'Best running shoes' query with AI-answer brand chips appearing, which shows the problem in under 5.5 s; strong and on-category but a familiar framing rather than a surprising one.

clarity.evidence: Each feature is paired with a matching UI view and a VO-synced highlight (AI responses, cited pages, competitor gaps, topics, search demand, web/YouTube/TikTok/Reddit visibility), and kinetic-type cards break the sections. Docked for density (many rapid page swaps in s005-s009) and a number mismatch: VO says 'nearly 200 million' (w208-w210) while the counter lands on 250,000,000+ and s031 shows 250M+.

ui_showcase.evidence: Real product UI throughout the demo beats, staged on a tilted 3D plane with push-ins, column washes, gradient outlines and an expanding nested panel (s008); a broad feature tour. Some screens are dense and are on screen for under 2 s, so detail is hard to read.

motion_polish.evidence: Consistent eased camera drift on UI, blur and zoom-through transitions, a speed-ramped motion-blurred carousel, a count-up and a bespoke 3D terrain/radar sequence; motion is coherent across 32 shots. Some in-shot page swaps in the UI sections read as hard content replacements rather than designed transitions.

sound_design.evidence: Judged from anchors audio facts plus visuals, not by listening: a steady 120.19 BPM music bed, integrated loudness -10.34 LUFS (loud, web-mastered), and 57 SFX candidates over 171.7 s, mostly labelled music, swoosh_reverse or unsure, clustering around transitions (about 48-52 s, 72-76 s and 146-149 s, matching the s008-s009, s015 and carousel moves). Competent and transition-aware, but no distinctive sonic signature can be confirmed from the data.

vo_script_quality.evidence: Clear problem-mechanism-demo-proof-outcome arc, benefit-led sentences, conversational pivots ('But wait,' w305-w306; 'Oh, and Reddit?' w351-w353) and a bookend that returns to 'your customers search everywhere' (w368-w372, w419-w422). Somewhat list-like in the feature middle and the 200 million vs 250M+ inconsistency weakens the proof.

brand_consistency.evidence: The same dark-blue-to-peach gradient dome frames the opener, kinetic cards, data cards, heritage carousel and end card; highlight colours (yellow wash, orange-to-yellow outline) repeat across all UI beats; the orange-'a' ahrefs wordmark closes the film, and the 'Best running shoes' query motif returns at s026.

works_muted.evidence: Muted, a viewer sees a polished tour of an analytics product and the closing tagline, but most of the argument (what each screen means, why third-party mentions matter, the heritage claim) lives only in the VO; UI sections carry no explanatory captions, only highlights.

overall.evidence: A premium, highly on-brand launch film with a bespoke radar metaphor, tightly VO-synced UI callouts and an effective heritage carousel; held back from best-in-class by its 2:52 length and density, heavy reliance on VO, and a minor stat inconsistency.

localization_friendliness.notes: English is baked into real product UI screenshots, the archival homepages, the research-article cards and the kinetic taglines ('No setup', 'No waiting time', 'Stay discoverable in search, AI, and beyond.'), and VO-word-timed highlights would need re-timing for a new language. The gradient, 3D radar and logo sections (s002, s003, s022) are language-neutral and reusable.
